name: YAML / JSON Converter
description: Convert YAML configuration files to JSON and JSON to clean YAML locally in your browser with syntax validation and indentation controls.
search_intent: Convert YAML to JSON or JSON to YAML online with syntax validation.

inputs.label: Input YAML or JSON content
inputs.default:
name: Navorika
version: 1.0.0
features:
  - client-side privacy
  - deterministic math
enabled: true
port: 3000

calculation: Client-side conversion using the robust YAML specification parser. In yaml-to-json mode, YAML.parse is executed inside a try/catch sandbox; line and column syntax errors are surfaced clearly. If valid, JSON.stringify emits formatted JSON with selected indentation. In json-to-yaml mode, JSON.parse parses the input structure and YAML.stringify emits standard YAML. Processing is entirely local in the browser; no data is sent over the network.
limitations: YAML circular references and custom application tags (!include, !Ref) are not serialized into standard JSON.
Undefined values and BigInt representations require standard JSON-compatible types.
Very large configuration files (>10 MB) may cause browser tab lag during syntax tree parsing.
